args.title: Ironbark Tooling newsletter — Cold-chain logistics in 2026
args.body:
- **Newsletter:** Ironbark Tooling's latest issue (subject: "Cold-chain logistics in 2026") is a single-topic send pointing to their blog post at blog.ironbark.example/2026/cold-chain; the companion piece requires free registration, done via an email-tagged link (no password).
- **Article (Cold-chain logistics in 2026):** Temperature excursions fell 30% at carriers that shared live sensor data — and most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than from less spoilage.
- **Companion piece:** Reports that pilots cut claims by a quarter. Accessed by registering with daniel.ferreira@northwind.example.
